notes.title: Flux Caves Linux support + optmizations patch!
notes.notes:
Here is the version 1.08 from Flux Caves and it contains some bigger changes! 


 First of all, the Linux support is live again!
 Also I made a main menu, where you can turn off  Volumetric Lights which will help for some Linux player, and without it you can earn some extra FPS
 Optimized almost all the levels, and the 'OpenWorld' too. This means about 5-30 extra frame per second


Also here is the first screenshot of the first free DLC. Which will contain 10 extra levels (ETA 2019 Nov/Dec)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35138580/df5c0b7bd0f2ab477cea91608ac491530ec0f2a4.jpg

notes.title: The newest update for Flux Caves is here! - Patch 1.06
notes.notes:
After plenty of optimalization, FPS rate is now 10-40% higher in general. Both the inner and outer areas have been reworked.
 Because I wanted players to take in the environment, I have added a collectible cake to every indoor level.
 The Steam achievement system has now been included! Currently, there are 2 achievements, one for completing the game and one for finding every cake.

notes.title: Patch 1.03 is here for Windows users
notes.notes:
Level 12 is a bit easier from now, more space to "store" blocks
 Some hidden border placed on level09 to prevent player push blocks of the edge
 Two new easter eggs added
 Fixed a bug which caused you spawned at wrong position after reseting saved data
 From now there is no blocking wall in the Free Demo version, but the players can finish only 5 puzzles. After that you have to buy the game.
